acceptance: The comment scanner identifies and decomposes command strings passed to recognized runners like ssh, watch, or xargs into individual commands for interpreter scanning
Regression test verifies comments in single-string runner invocations are detected
context: Documented as a known scanner gap in docs/development/comment-policy.md: commands passed to a runner such as ssh or watch as one string are not split, so an interpreter inside that string is not followed.
description: In scripts/comment_execution.py, commands passed to execution runners such as ssh, watch, or xargs as a single quoted string argument are currently not tokenized or decomposed into subcommands. As a result, nested interpreter invocations (e.g. ssh host python -c '...') inside runner strings can bypass comment and docstring scanning. Extend the execution analyzer to split runner arguments and inspect nested scripts.
